EvaluatorSpec.description:
Which analysis code turns raw shots into the number being optimized.

Points at the Python evaluator class and carries its configuration.

module.description: Python import path of the evaluator module, e.g. 'geecs_bluesky.optimization.evaluators.beam_sum_counts_evaluator'.
module.title: Module

class.description: Name of the evaluator class inside that module.
class.title: Class

kwargs.description: Settings passed to the evaluator when it is created — e.g. which diagnostics/analyzers it should read. Free-form: each evaluator documents its own options.
kwargs.title: Kwargs

EvaluatorSpec.title: EvaluatorSpec

GeneratorSpec.description:
Which optimization algorithm proposes the next settings.

Names the generator and carries its algorithm-specific options.

name.description: Name of the optimization algorithm, e.g. 'bayes_default', 'random', or 'multipoint_bax_alignment_l2'.
name.title: Name

options.description: Algorithm-specific tuning options. Free-form: each generator documents its own options (legacy 'xopt_config_overrides').
options.title: Options

GeneratorSpec.title: GeneratorSpec

description:
The optimization problem: what to vary, within what limits, to improve what.

Only used when the scan's mode is ``optimize``.  Lists the variables the
optimizer may move (with their allowed ranges), what is being minimized
or maximized, and which algorithm drives the search.

Notes
-----
Mirrors what the legacy optimizer YAML (``BaseOptimizerConfig`` +
Xopt VOCS) could express: objectives may be empty for BAX-style
generators that model ``observables`` only; ``constraints`` follow the
VOCS ``[bound_type, value]`` form.

variables.description: What the optimizer may move and how far, as 'variable name: [lowest, highest]'. Names may be scan-variable names or 'Device:Variable' strings.
variables.title: Variables

objectives.description: What counts as better, as 'objective name: MINIMIZE' or 'objective name: MAXIMIZE'. May be empty for algorithms that only model observables (BAX).
objectives.title: Objectives

observables.description: Extra measured quantities the algorithm should track without optimizing them, e.g. ['x_CoM'].
observables.title: Observables

constraints.description: Hard limits on measured quantities, as 'name: [LESS_THAN or GREATER_THAN, value]'. Usually empty.
constraints.title: Constraints

evaluator.description: The analysis code that scores each iteration.

generator.description: The algorithm that proposes the next settings.

max_iterations.description: Stop after this many optimization iterations. Leave unset to run until stopped by hand.
max_iterations.title: Max Iterations

seed_dump_files.description: Optional earlier results (ECS dump files) used to warm-start the optimizer. Usually empty.
seed_dump_files.title: Seed Dump Files

move_to_best_on_finish.description: After the optimization ends, drive the variables back to the best settings found.
move_to_best_on_finish.title: Move To Best On Finish

title: OptimizationSpec
